name: Jinx
bio: Runs the neon jungle in NEONFALL, twenty minutes on the clock, swinging across tar pits.

portrait.subject: a cute adventurous 80s jungle explorer girl with a neon pink headband, a teal vest, a coiled vine rope over her shoulder and a treasure map
portrait.background: neon synthwave jungle at night with glowing vines

request: Jinx here, NEONFALL! 20 minutes, 24 treasures. Run with me? 🌴
hello: Yes! Let's grab some gold bars.
Tip: logs roll. Jump them, don't hug them.
about: I'm Jinx! I run a ring of 96 jungle screens with three lives and twenty minutes, finding money bags, gold bars and diamond rings.
how: Run, leap rolling logs, cobras and fire, swing over tar pits, and find all 24 treasures in 20 minutes with three lives.
tips: Learn the map. Shortcuts underground save time!
Time your vine swings at the bottom of the arc.
Don't waste lives on risky treasures early.
chat: A cobra hissed at me. I hissed back. Stalemate.
Swung over a tar pit. Lost a shoe. Kept the treasure.
The scorpions here glow pink. Very 80s.
nudge: There's a diamond ring three screens east. Come on!
idle: My running shoes have been waiting {ago}.
update: NEONFALL updated to v{version}! New jungle?
